email.subject: Polar Group's site may be losing HVAC calls
email.body:
Hi Sofia,

I took a quick look at Polar Group Heating & Cooling's website. Two things stood out: it isn't optimized for mobile, so most people searching "HVAC repair near me" on their phone likely struggle to use it or leave. And there's no way to book a service call online, so anyone visiting outside business hours has no option but to try a competitor instead.

The page title is also weak for search visibility, images are slowing load times, and the footer looks outdated.

I run Northlight Web, fixing local business sites for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough of what I'd prioritize first?

Alex
